referendum, naming nearly but one Methusaleh at the table. Player A is

have

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>One of the minions of Player A has called and passed the Rumors of Gehenna
>referendum, naming nearly but one Methusaleh at the table. Player A is
>subsequently ousted. Do the remaining Methusalehs lose their ability to
>have
>two Master phase actions a turn??
>

Unless control of the Rumours was transferred to someone else (via Succubus
Club for example) then yes, the Methusalehs lose the extra Master phase action.
Rumours is a minion card and is thus controlled by the Methusaleh who put it
into play so when that Methusaleh (A) is ousted, the card is burned and the
effects are ended.

Halcyan 2
